changes: Deleted five confirmed-dead, git-tracked paths for the open-source release: the three unused sample/dogfood packages packages/cli-guess-number, packages/python-demo, packages/python-rps, and two tracked cruft files du.exe.stackdump (a Windows crash dump) and claude-session.mjs (a dead prototype superseded by packages/main/src/providers/claude-cli.ts). jek.md was deliberately kept (user-owned).
usage: Nothing to invoke — the repository simply ships without the sample projects and junk files. `ls packages/` now shows only lab/main/utils.
expectedOutcome: `ls packages/` prints only `lab main utils`; `git ls-files` no longer lists any of the five deleted paths; jek.md is still present and tracked; `npm run build`, `npm run test:e2e`, and `lattice validate` all pass.
actualTranscript: ls packages/ = 'lab main utils'; 0 deleted paths in git index; git ls-files jek.md still returns jek.md; npm run build exit 0; npm run test:e2e exit 0 (story-lifecycle + gap-convergence ALL PASS); lattice validate exit 0 with 25/25 verification intent coverage; all 3 REVIEW lanes and delivery-check passed with no findings.
outcomeDiff: No gap. The five dead paths are gone from git and disk; jek.md survives; build/e2e/validate green; over-deletion guards (packages/lab, experiments/, root markdown files, bin/lattice.js) all confirmed intact.
limitations: Scope was deliberately limited to these five paths. jek.md (user-owned), packages/lab, and the experiments/ committed-data drop are intentionally out of scope; the experiments/ data-drop is a planned separate follow-up story.
pitfalls: jek.md is protected by decisions/root-markdown-migration-execution-solution.md and must not be deleted without explicit user request — an earlier story (B-15d2) was discarded because its frozen checklist named jek.md as a deletion target; this story names it only as kept. claude-session.mjs leaves an acceptable historical mention in docs/metadata/task.json and a coincidental '.tmp-claude-session' string in claude-cli.ts:58 (not an import).
